title: Standings double-count seasons 2012-2019 (overlapping Brasileirão datasets, no dedup)
evidence: src/data-loader.ts:156-225 buildNormalizedMatches concatenates Brasileirao_Matches.csv (2012-2022) and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (2003-2019) with no dedup; verified against raw CSVs: Flamengo 2019 = 38 matches/90 pts in EACH file, and getStandings (src/query-engine.ts:210-268) filters competition via substring includes ('brasileirao' matches both 'Brasileirão Série A' and '... (historical)'), so 2019 standings report 76 matches/180 pts per team. Rankings survive (uniform doubling) but points/match counts are 2x for 2012-2019.
suggestion: Dedup on (date, home, away) when merging, or drop novo_campeonato rows with Ano >= 2012

title: getTeamStats W/L/D and goals doubled for seasons 2012-2019 (same missing-dedup root cause as R9)
evidence: src/query-engine.ts:101-154 getTeamStats iterates db.matches which contains both copies of every 2012-2019 Brasileirão fixture; verified: Flamengo 2019 sums to 76 matches, 180 points. All-time aggregates inflated by the 8-season overlap.
suggestion: Same fix as R9 — dedup in buildNormalizedMatches

title: headToHead counts doubled and match list has duplicate rows for seasons 2012-2019 (same root cause as R9)
evidence: src/query-engine.ts:158-206 headToHead filters db.matches; every 2012-2019 Brasileirão fixture appears twice (competition labels 'Brasileirão Série A' and '... (historical)'), so W/L/D and goal tallies are 2x over that span and the returned match list contains duplicates.
suggestion: Same fix as R9 — dedup in buildNormalizedMatches

title: searchMatches and getBiggestWins return duplicate rows for 2012-2019 fixtures
evidence: src/query-engine.ts:21-97 and :362-380 operate on the un-deduped db.matches; a 2012-2019 fixture matching a query is listed twice (once per source label), and a large-margin 2012-2019 win occupies two slots in the biggest-wins top-N. R3-R5/R10 still function (matches are found; avg goals/match and home-win rate are ratio stats essentially unaffected by uniform duplication), so scored implemented, not partial.
suggestion: Same fix as R9; optionally keep source label in an extra field after dedup

title: Tests assert only internal consistency, never absolute values, so the double-count is invisible to the suite
evidence: src/tests/query-engine.test.ts (24 tests) checks e.g. wins+draws+losses === matches and result ordering, but never a known ground-truth value (e.g. Flamengo 2019 = 38 matches, 90 points); all 34 tests pass (test_coverage=1.0) despite the R9/R6/R11 defect.
suggestion: Add at least one absolute-value fixture assertion per aggregate tool
